import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    text = input[1]
    MOD = 51123987
    prefix_sums = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    def expand_around_center(left, right):
        count = 0
        while left >= 0 and right < n and text[left] == text[right]:
            count += 1
            left -= 1
            right += 1
        return count
    
    for center in range(n):
        prefix_sums[center + 1] = prefix_sums[center] + expand_around_center(center, center)
        if center < n - 1:
            prefix_sums[center + 2] = prefix_sums[center + 1] + expand_around_center(center, center + 1)
    
    total_crossings = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        total_crossings += (prefix_sums[n] - prefix_sums[i]) * (i - 1 - (prefix_sums[i] - prefix_sums[i - 1]))
    
    print(total_crossings % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
